lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged posterior to the pectoral fin, forming a non-uniform grid of approximately 15-20 distinct nodes in the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the dorsal-lateral region, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the upper edge and shadow on the lower edge.
